hero.title: Auth & Authorization for your app
hero.subtitle: {{appName}} gives your app policy-based access control, audit trails, and session security, so you can spend less time rebuilding auth from scratch.

authentication.title: Authentication
authentication.description: Password + Google OAuth2, refresh-token rotation, brute-force lockout.

authorization.title: PBAC authorization
authorization.description: Access decided by assigned policies, not a hardcoded role check.

auditLog.title: Audit logging
auditLog.description: Every session event and access decision recorded, queryable per user.

selfHosted.title: Self-hosted
selfHosted.description: Runs on your own VPS - Postgres, Valkey, and every audit log stay on infrastructure you control.
